blocks.original_text: ABSTRACT
blocks.translation: 摘要

blocks.original_text: High Bandwidth Flash (HBF) has recently emerged as a promising technology that provides terabyte-scale accelerator-local capacity at bandwidths approaching HBM, with a potential cost-per-bit advantage over HBM. However, its NAND foundation brings long latency, out-of-place updates, and finite write endurance directly into the accelerator memory hierarchy, making its effects on performance and lifetime difficult to predict. To study this emerging design space, we present HBFSim, an LLM-aware event-driven simulator for heterogeneous HBM+HBF memory systems that preserves application-level memory semantics while modeling flash-internal behavior. HBFSim models HBM, HBF with host-managed flash translation, and conventional capacity tiers in one simulation driven by a calibrated serving frontend. Using HBFSim, we study decoding of Llama-3.1-70B and Qwen3-235B-A22B under three workloads that differ in their input and output lengths. HBF serves data that does not fit in HBM 11.0–19.0× faster than host DRAM; HBM is better used to hold the running sequences’ KV cache than as a cache for HBF; and at a published peak load of Llama-3.1-70B, HBF lasts 2.0 to 6.9 years, in proportion to the stacks that share the KV writes. The artifact is available at https://github.com/FlashLabAE/HBFSim and will track public HBF device data as it becomes available.
blocks.translation: 高带宽闪存（High Bandwidth Flash，HBF）近期成为一种颇具潜力的技术：它能够在加速器本地提供 TB 级容量，带宽接近 HBM，每比特成本也可能优于 HBM。然而，其 NAND 基础将较长的访问延迟、异地更新和有限的写入耐久性直接带入加速器存储层次，使其对性能与寿命的影响难以预测。为研究这一新兴设计空间，我们提出 HBFSim：一个面向 LLM 的事件驱动模拟器，用于异构 HBM＋HBF 存储系统，在建模闪存内部行为的同时保留应用层访存语义。HBFSim 由经过校准的推理服务前端驱动，在同一次模拟中建模 HBM、采用主机管理地址转换的 HBF，以及常规容量层。我们使用 HBFSim，针对输入和输出长度不同的三种工作负载，研究 Llama-3.1-70B 与 Qwen3-235B-A22B 的解码。对于 HBM 放不下的数据，HBF 的服务速度比主机 DRAM 快 11.0–19.0 倍；与其将 HBM 用作 HBF 的缓存，不如用它保存运行中序列的 KV 缓存；在已公布的 Llama-3.1-70B 峰值负载下，HBF 的预计寿命为 2.0–6.9 年，并与分担 KV 写入的堆栈数量成正比。代码与实验产物位于 https://github.com/FlashLabAE/HBFSim ，并将在公开 HBF 器件数据出现后持续跟进。

blocks.original_text: 1 INTRODUCTION
blocks.translation: 1 引言

source_fragments.text: 1 INTRODUCTION

blocks.original_text: Memory capacity has emerged as a primary bottleneck in serving large language models (LLMs). Model weights occupy tens to hundreds of gigabytes, while key–value (KV) state grows linearly with context length and request concurrency, quickly exceeding accelerator memory capacity. For example, an 8B model serving eight concurrent 128K-context sessions can exhaust the HBM of a modern GPU (e.g., the 131 GiB of HBM3e on an NVIDIA H200), while long-context serving for 70B-class models may exceed the memory capacity of an entire eight-GPU node [5, 11, 17, 22]. High Bandwidth Flash (HBF) has recently emerged as a promising approach for extending accelerator-local memory capacity. SanDisk’s disclosed HBF design targets a 16-die, 512 GB flash stack that delivers up to 1.6 TB/s [24, 25], enabling multi-terabyte accelerator-local memory systems without host-memory accesses. The same disclosure targets 8–16× HBM capacity at similar cost and bandwidth, making capacity per dollar, rather than higher speed, the main motivation for HBF [24].
blocks.translation: 存储容量已成为大语言模型（LLM）推理服务的主要瓶颈。模型权重占用数十至数百 GB，而键值（KV）状态随上下文长度和请求并发数线性增长，很快就会超出加速器的存储容量。例如，一个 8B 模型同时服务八个 128K 上下文会话，就可能耗尽现代 GPU 的 HBM，例如 NVIDIA H200 上的 131 GiB HBM3e；70B 级模型的长上下文服务甚至可能超出整个八 GPU 节点的存储容量 [5, 11, 17, 22]。高带宽闪存（HBF）近期成为扩展加速器本地存储容量的一条潜在路径。SanDisk 已披露的 HBF 设计以 16 裸片、512 GB 闪存堆栈为目标，带宽最高为 1.6 TB/s [24, 25]，由此可以在不访问主机内存的情况下构建多 TB 的加速器本地存储系统。同一披露还提出，在成本与带宽相近的条件下，容量达到 HBM 的 8–16 倍。因此，推动 HBF 的主要动力是单位成本所能提供的容量，而非更高的速度 [24]。

blocks.original_text: Unlike conventional DRAM expansion, HBF brings asymmetric read and write performance, page programming, flash translation layer (FTL) management, write amplification, and finite program/erase endurance into the accelerator memory hierarchy. Its effect on LLM serving is difficult to predict because no public HBF hardware is available for validation [28]. Nevertheless, system architects must decide on memory organization, placement policies, and provisioning before production devices become available. For example, moving read-only weights to HBF mainly exercises its read path and frees HBM for the growing KV cache, whereas placing mutable KV state in HBF creates program traffic and consumes write endurance. Therefore, it is necessary to study the performance of HBM+HBF memory hierarchies under realistic LLM serving workloads before committing to a design. Because such hardware is unavailable, a simulator is required to evaluate these trade-offs.
blocks.translation: 与常规 DRAM 扩容不同，HBF 将不对称的读写性能、页编程、闪存转换层（FTL）管理、写放大和有限的编程／擦除耐久性带入加速器存储层次。由于尚无公开的 HBF 硬件可用于验证，它对 LLM 推理服务的影响很难预测 [28]。尽管如此，系统架构师仍须在量产器件出现前决定存储组织、放置策略及资源配置。例如，将只读权重移至 HBF，主要利用其读取路径，并为不断增长的 KV 缓存释放 HBM；而把可修改的 KV 状态放入 HBF，会产生编程流量并消耗写入耐久性。因此，在确定设计前，有必要在真实的 LLM 推理服务工作负载下研究 HBM＋HBF 存储层次的性能。由于这类硬件尚不可用，需要模拟器来评估这些取舍。

None connects the placement of LLM data to both completion time and physical flash traffic.

blocks.original_text: HBFSim addresses this limitation. It models HBM, HBF with a host-managed FTL, and conventional capacity tiers in one event system, coupled in a closed loop with a serving frontend whose scheduler and GPU compute are calibrated against measurements, and it accepts address-level traces as well as production request traces. Using HBFSim, we study decoding of Llama-3.1-70B and Qwen3-235B-A22B under three workloads that differ in their input and output lengths. We find that HBF serves the data that does not fit in HBM 11.0–19.0× faster than host DRAM; that HBM should hold the running sequences’ KV, because caching HBF with LRU or FIFO rereads nearly the whole working set once it exceeds HBM, and that KV should be written to HBF only when it must leave HBM; and that the FTL costs little on the read path as long as its layout keeps reads parallel, while HBF’s lifetime depends on the amount of KV that reaches flash. These findings connect HBF’s potential cost-per-bit advantage to measurable latency and wear rather than to a single capacity or bandwidth number.
blocks.translation: HBFSim 旨在弥补这一局限。它在同一个事件系统中建模 HBM、采用主机端 FTL 的 HBF，以及常规容量层，并与推理服务前端构成闭环；前端的调度器和 GPU 计算模型均依据实测校准，同时接受地址级轨迹和生产请求轨迹。我们使用 HBFSim，在输入、输出长度不同的三种工作负载下研究 Llama-3.1-70B 和 Qwen3-235B-A22B 的解码。结果表明，对于 HBM 放不下的数据，HBF 的服务速度为主机 DRAM 的 11.0–19.0 倍；HBM 应保存运行中序列的 KV，因为一旦工作集超过 HBM，使用 LRU 或 FIFO 将 HBM 用作 HBF 缓存，几乎会反复读取整个工作集；KV 也应仅在必须离开 HBM 时才写入 HBF。只要映射布局能保持读取并行性，FTL 在读取路径上的成本就很小；HBF 寿命则取决于有多少 KV 到达闪存。这些发现把 HBF 潜在的每比特成本优势，与可量化的延迟和磨损联系起来，而不是仅以某个容量或带宽数值衡量它。

blocks.translation: 2 背景

source_fragments.text: 2 BACKGROUND

blocks.original_text: 2.1 Memory Demand of LLM Serving
blocks.translation: 2.1 LLM 推理服务的存储需求

source_fragments.text: 2.1 Memory Demand of LLM Serving

blocks.original_text: A serving system’s memory holds the model weights, which every request reuses; the KV cache, the per-layer keys and values of every processed token, which decoding reads instead of recomputing; and activations, which are small by comparison. For Llama-3.1-70B a BF16 KV cache takes 320 KiB per token [5], 320 GiB for 1M tokens. Serving systems allocate KV in fixed-size blocks [11] and retain the blocks of finished requests so that later requests with the same prefix skip its prefill [22, 37], so the KV footprint grows beyond the active requests. Figure 1 shows the weights and the KV cache of 1M tokens, in one request or retained across many: for small models the KV cache dominates, every model from 70B up exceeds eight HBM4 stacks, and the newest open models, with 1.6T to 2.8T parameters, exceed even an eight-H200 node with their weights alone, while hybrid or compressed attention keeps their KV small.
blocks.translation: 推理服务系统的存储中保存三类数据：所有请求复用的模型权重；KV 缓存，即每个已处理词元在各层产生的键和值，解码时读取它们以避免重新计算；以及相比之下较小的激活数据。对于 Llama-3.1-70B，BF16 KV 缓存每个词元需要 320 KiB [5]，100 万词元即为 320 GiB。推理服务系统按固定大小的块分配 KV [11]，并保留已完成请求的块，使后续具有相同前缀的请求可以跳过相应的预填充 [22, 37]；因此，KV 占用会超出活跃请求本身。图 1 展示了权重与 100 万词元 KV 缓存的容量需求，这些词元既可以来自一个请求，也可以跨多个请求保留：对于小模型，KV 缓存占主导；从 70B 开始，所有模型的需求都超过八个 HBM4 堆栈；最新的开放模型参数量达 1.6T–2.8T，仅权重就超过一个八 H200 节点的容量，而混合注意力或压缩注意力会使其 KV 较小。

blocks.original_text: The two phases of a request access this data differently. Prefill processes the prompt, produces its KV, and is usually compute-bound; chunked prefill lets it share a batch with decoding work [2]. Each decoding step generates one token per request: it reuses the weights across the batch, reads every running request’s KV, and appends one token’s KV per layer, so it is usually bound by memory bandwidth, and its traffic grows with model size, batch, and context. When weights and KV exceed HBM, systems offload to host DRAM or SSDs [15, 22, 26], at access costs set by the slower tier and its interconnect.
blocks.translation: 请求的两个阶段以不同方式访问这些数据。预填充处理提示词并生成其 KV，通常受计算能力限制；分块预填充使其能够与解码任务共用一个批次 [2]。每个解码步为每个请求生成一个词元：它在整个批次内复用权重，读取所有运行中请求的 KV，并在每层追加一个词元的 KV。因此，解码通常受存储带宽限制，其流量随模型规模、批量和上下文增长。权重与 KV 超过 HBM 容量时，系统会将数据卸载到主机 DRAM 或 SSD [15, 22, 26]，访问成本由较慢的层级及其互连决定。

source_fragments.text: The two phases of a request access this data differently. Prefill
processes the prompt, produces its KV, and is usually compute-
bound; chunked prefill lets it share a batch with decoding work [2].
Each decoding step generates one token per request: it reuses the
weights across the batch, reads every running request’s KV, and
appends one token’s KV per layer, so it is usually bound by memory
bandwidth, and its traffic grows with model size, batch, and context.
When weights and KV exceed HBM, systems offload to host DRAM
or SSDs [15, 22, 26], at access costs set by the slower tier and its
interconnect.

blocks.original_text: 2.2 High Bandwidth Flash
blocks.translation: 2.2 高带宽闪存

source_fragments.text: 2.2 High Bandwidth Flash

blocks.original_text: HBF stacks NAND flash dies on a logic base die and connects them to the accelerator through an HBM-like interface in the same package [24, 25]. The OCP HBF specification [19] defines stacks with up to 16 channels and three speed grades. For example, at speed grade 2 each channel carries 96 GB/s of payload, or about 1.5 TB/s per stack, and SanDisk targets 512 GB per stack. An HBF stack therefore offers 8-16 times the capacity of an HBM stack at a similar interface bandwidth.
blocks.translation: HBF 将 NAND 闪存裸片堆叠在逻辑基底裸片上，并通过同一封装内类似 HBM 的接口连接加速器 [24, 25]。OCP HBF 规范 [19] 定义了最多 16 个通道和三个速度等级。例如，速度等级 2 中每个通道承载 96 GB/s 的有效载荷，约为每堆栈 1.5 TB/s；SanDisk 则以每堆栈 512 GB 为目标。因此，在接口带宽相近时，HBF 堆栈能够提供 HBM 堆栈 8–16 倍的容量。

blocks.original_text: However, HBF still behaves like NAND. A page read takes microseconds, compared to tens of nanoseconds of DRAM, so HBF reaches its bandwidth only with many reads in flight. Data is programmed, not overwritten: a page program takes tens of microseconds and occupies its bank, and a block must be erased before its pages are programmed again. The specification assigns address mapping, garbage collection (GC), and wear leveling to host software; the device itself performs neither GC nor copyback [19]. Each block tolerates a limited number of program/erase (P/E) cycles, and no P/E rating for HBF has been published. Host decisions thus shape both performance and lifetime: what the host places in HBF determines the traffic HBF sees, and the host’s flash translation layer (FTL) determines how many erases each write costs.
blocks.translation: 然而，HBF 仍具有 NAND 的行为特征。页读取耗时为微秒量级，而 DRAM 为数十纳秒，因此只有同时存在大量在途读取时，HBF 才能达到其带宽。数据通过编程写入，而非直接覆盖：一次页编程需要数十微秒，并占用其存储体；同一块中的页再次编程前，必须先擦除整个块。规范将地址映射、垃圾回收（GC）和磨损均衡交给主机软件，器件本身既不执行 GC，也不执行内部复制回写（copyback）[19]。每个块可承受的编程／擦除（P/E）循环数有限，且目前尚未公布 HBF 的 P/E 额定值。因此，主机端的决策同时塑造性能和寿命：主机将什么数据放入 HBF，决定 HBF 接收什么流量；主机端闪存转换层（FTL）则决定每次写入付出多少擦除成本。

blocks.original_text: 2.3 Questions for HBM+HBF Systems
blocks.translation: 2.3 HBM＋HBF 系统需要回答的问题

source_fragments.text: 2.3 Questions for HBM+HBF Systems

blocks.original_text: Before HBF hardware is available, system designers need to answer five questions. Is HBF a better capacity tier than host DRAM or SSDs? How much HBM should accompany it? Which data should stay in HBM, and should HBM act as a cache for HBF or as separately addressed memory? How should the FTL handle KV writes? How long will HBF last under serving traffic? The answers depend on each other through the serving loop: slower memory stretches decoding steps, which changes how requests are batched and therefore the memory traffic itself. Answering them requires running a real serving scheduler against memory models that include flash management, with the two coupled in a closed loop.
blocks.translation: 在 HBF 硬件可用之前，系统设计者需要回答五个问题：HBF 是否比主机 DRAM 或 SSD 更适合作为容量层？应搭配多少 HBM？哪些数据应留在 HBM 中，HBM 应作为 HBF 的缓存，还是作为独立寻址的存储？FTL 应如何处理 KV 写入？HBF 在推理服务流量下能使用多久？这些答案通过推理服务循环相互影响：较慢的存储会拉长解码步，进而改变请求的批次组织，也改变存储流量本身。要回答这些问题，需要让真实的推理服务调度器与包含闪存管理的存储模型交互，并将二者耦合成闭环。

blocks.original_text: 3 HBFSIM DESIGN
blocks.translation: 3 HBFSim 设计

source_fragments.text: 3 HBFSIM DESIGN

blocks.original_text: HBFSim is a closed-loop simulator of LLM serving on accelerator memory built from HBM, HBF, and other capacity tiers. Figure 2 shows its three layers. A serving frontend turns request traces into batches and the requests in each batch into memory accesses. A policy layer decides in which memory each object is stored and how data moves between tiers. A device engine executes the memory transactions on models of HBM, HBF, or external capacity tiers, and feeds the outcome of that work back to the frontend, which schedules the next batch based on the feedback. Slower memory therefore reshapes batching as it would on a real system: longer iterations let more requests queue before the next one starts, and when KV no longer fits, the scheduler moves some KV to a slower tier or preempts requests, which shrinks the batch. Three challenges shape this design.
blocks.translation: HBFSim 是面向 LLM 推理服务的闭环模拟器，其加速器存储由 HBM、HBF 及其他容量层组成。图 2 展示了其三个层次。推理服务前端将请求轨迹转成批次，再把批次中的请求转成访存操作。策略层决定每个对象保存在哪种存储中，以及数据如何在层间移动。器件引擎在 HBM、HBF 或外部容量层模型上执行存储事务，并把结果反馈给前端；前端再依据反馈调度下一个批次。因此，较慢的存储会像真实系统中那样重塑批次组织：更长的迭代使更多请求在下次迭代开始前进入队列；当 KV 放不下时，调度器会把部分 KV 移往较慢层级，或抢占请求，从而缩小批量。三个挑战决定了这种设计。

blocks.original_text: Workloads and device accesses differ in granularity and semantics. A serving system works with requests, weights, and KV blocks; HBM serves data bursts of tens of bytes; and HBF is accessed like memory but programs flash pages (e.g., 4 KiB) in order, erases whole flash blocks, and leaves its FTL to the host. Address-level traces preserve individual accesses but can only cover short runs, whereas production request traces cover long periods of serving but record no memory accesses.
blocks.translation: 工作负载与器件访问的粒度和语义不同。推理服务系统处理请求、权重和 KV 块；HBM 提供数十字节的突发传输；HBF 虽以类似内存的方式访问，却按顺序编程闪存页（例如 4 KiB），整块擦除，并把 FTL 留给主机。地址级轨迹保留单次访问，但只能覆盖短时间运行；生产请求轨迹则覆盖长时间推理服务，却不记录访存操作。

blocks.original_text: The levels of the memory hierarchy are coupled. Existing simulators model one level in isolation, but in an HBM+HBF system the two levels jointly determine performance. What HBF must serve depends on what HBM can hold, and the traffic HBF generates in turn consumes HBM capacity and bandwidth. Placement decisions therefore shift load between the tiers rather than simply adding a slower level beneath HBM, so neither tier can be simulated independently.
blocks.translation: 存储层次中的各级相互耦合。现有模拟器孤立地建模某一层，但在 HBM＋HBF 系统中，两层共同决定性能。HBF 必须服务什么数据，取决于 HBM 能放下什么；HBF 产生的流量反过来又会消耗 HBM 的容量和带宽。因此，放置决策是在各层之间转移负载，而不只是简单地在 HBM 下面增加一层较慢的存储，任何一层都不能独立模拟。

blocks.original_text: 3.1 Serving Frontend
blocks.translation: 3.1 推理服务前端

source_fragments.text: 3.1 Serving Frontend

blocks.original_text: HBFSim accepts workloads at two granularities. In an address-level trace, a record is one memory access with optional data class, arrival time, and layer annotations; such traces are replayed directly. Detailed instruction-and-address tracing and cycle-level simulation incur substantial costs even for a small inference workload. For Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct (bfloat16, batch size 1), a 32-token prefill followed by two fixed-token decode steps required 43.4 minutes for trace collection on an RTX 4000 Ada with NVBit [30]. The resulting 1,030-kernel traces occupy 98.3 GiB uncompressed, or 7.46 GiB in the compressed format consumed by Accel-Sim2.0 [20]. Full trace-driven simulation already takes 19.9 wall-clock hours even for a small model. For larger models, both the trace size and simulation time would become prohibitively large, rendering this approach unrealistic.
blocks.translation: HBFSim 接受两种粒度的工作负载。在地址级轨迹中，每条记录对应一次访存，并可附带数据类别、到达时间和层标注；这类轨迹直接回放。即便推理工作负载很小，详细的指令与地址追踪、周期级模拟也会产生显著成本。对于 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct（bfloat16，批量为 1），在 RTX 4000 Ada 上用 NVBit [30] 采集一个 32 词元预填充及随后两个固定词元解码步的轨迹，需要 43.4 分钟。得到的 1,030 个内核轨迹未经压缩时占 98.3 GiB，转换成 Accel-Sim2.0 [20] 使用的压缩格式后仍为 7.46 GiB。即使模型很小，完整的轨迹驱动模拟也已需要 19.9 小时实际运行时间。对于更大的模型，轨迹大小与模拟时间都会增长到难以承受，使这种方法不切实际。

blocks.original_text: In a request-level trace, a record is one inference request: its arrival time, prompt and output lengths, and prefix hashes [22, 31]. It contains no detailed memory accesses. Which bytes an inference step touches does not depend on the values it computes, only on the model architecture and on which requests the scheduler runs with how many tokens (for MoE models, also on the routed experts, which depend on the values and are therefore an input, recorded or synthetic). The frontend, ServeLoop, therefore regenerates the accesses of every step. Its scheduler replays the trace with vLLM’s continuous batching and chunked prefill [2, 11, 35], including paged KV, prefix sharing, and preemption. A compiler turns each iteration into the byte ranges that every operator reads or writes in weight tensors, KV blocks, and embedding rows, leaving addresses and memories to the policies. A decoding step of Llama-3.1-70B under the workload with 32 sequences and 6K tokens of context becomes $1.8\times10^5$ such transactions.
blocks.translation: 在请求级轨迹中，每条记录对应一次推理请求，包含到达时间、提示词与输出长度，以及前缀哈希 [22, 31]，并不包含详细访存。一个推理步会访问哪些字节，并不取决于它计算出的数值，而取决于模型架构、调度器运行哪些请求及各请求处理多少词元；对于 MoE 模型，还取决于路由到哪些专家，而路由与数值有关，因此将实测或合成的专家路由作为输入。前端 ServeLoop 由此重新生成每步访问。其调度器采用 vLLM 的连续批处理与分块预填充 [2, 11, 35] 回放轨迹，包括分页 KV、前缀共享及抢占。编译器将每次迭代转成各算子在权重张量、KV 块及嵌入行中读写的字节区间，具体地址与存储归属则交给策略层。在 32 个序列、6K 上下文词元的工作负载下，Llama-3.1-70B 的一个解码步被转成 $1.8\times10^5$ 个此类事务。

blocks.original_text: HBFSim times every batch, prefill and decode alike, using an operator-level GPU model. It decomposes each batch into operators and computes each operator’s time from three components: a fixed overhead, a compute time, and a memory-access time. The compute time is derived from the operator’s FLOPs and a compute-throughput coefficient fitted to measured kernels. We obtain the memory-access time from HBFSim’s detailed simulation of HBM and HBF accesses, rather than an ideal-bandwidth assumption. To stay anchored to real GPU behavior, we fit each operator’s fixed overhead, compute throughput, and memory bandwidth from measured kernels to establish a baseline time. During simulation, we replace the baseline’s ideal memory time with the simulated access time, while retaining the measured kernel’s additional memory overhead beyond the GPU’s peak bandwidth. The batch time is then the sum of all operator times. This design ensures that HBF latency and bandwidth directly affect each operator’s memory time, and thus the batch time, while the compute portion stays tied to measured GPU performance.
blocks.translation: HBFSim 用算子级 GPU 模型为每个批次计时，预填充和解码均如此。它将批次拆成算子，并从固定开销、计算时间和访存时间三部分计算每个算子的耗时。计算时间来自算子的 FLOPs，以及用实测内核拟合的计算吞吐系数。访存时间由 HBFSim 对 HBM 与 HBF 访问的详细模拟给出，而非理想带宽假设。为使模型保持与真实 GPU 行为一致，我们依据实测内核拟合各算子的固定开销、计算吞吐和存储带宽，建立基准时间。模拟时，用模拟得到的访问时间替换基准中的理想访存时间，同时保留实测内核相对于 GPU 峰值带宽所体现的额外访存开销。随后将所有算子时间相加得到批次时间。这样，HBF 的延迟与带宽会直接影响每个算子的访存时间，进而影响批次时间，而计算部分仍与实测 GPU 性能相联系。

source_fragments.text: HBFSim times every batch, prefill and decode alike, using an
operator-level GPU model. It decomposes each batch into opera-
tors and computes each operator’s time from three components: a
fixed overhead, a compute time, and a memory-access time. The
compute time is derived from the operator’s FLOPs and a compute-
throughput coefficient fitted to measured kernels. We obtain the
memory-access time from HBFSim’s detailed simulation of HBM
and HBF accesses, rather than an ideal-bandwidth assumption. To
stay anchored to real GPU behavior, we fit each operator’s fixed
overhead, compute throughput, and memory bandwidth from mea-
sured kernels to establish a baseline time. During simulation, we
replace the baseline’s ideal memory time with the simulated access
time, while retaining the measured kernel’s additional memory
overhead beyond the GPU’s peak bandwidth. The batch time is
then the sum of all operator times. This design ensures that HBF
latency and bandwidth directly affect each operator’s memory time,
and thus the batch time, while the compute portion stays tied to
measured GPU performance.

blocks.original_text: 3.2 Memory Policies
blocks.translation: 3.2 存储策略

source_fragments.text: 3.2 Memory Policies

blocks.original_text: HBFSim provides two ways to organize HBM and HBF. In peer mode, HBM and HBF form one address space, and each object is stored in one of them. HBM is filled in a priority order and the rest overflows to HBF: weights first places the weights, then KV blocks in address order, retained prefixes included; KV first places the running sequences’ KV, then the weights, then the retained prefixes. In tiered mode, HBM caches objects stored in the HBF or other capacity tier in 4 MiB lines with LRU, FIFO, or decayed-LFU [23] replacement; decayed LFU evicts the line with the fewest recent accesses and halves all access counts periodically, as in frequency-based replacement [23]. Dirty data is tracked at 4 KiB granularity, and dirty KV is written back either eagerly, while compute leaves the link idle [12], or only when its line is evicted. KV released before eviction is discarded without being written.
blocks.translation: HBFSim 提供两种组织 HBM 与 HBF 的方式。在并列模式（peer mode）中，HBM 与 HBF 构成同一地址空间，每个对象保存在其中之一。系统按优先级填充 HBM，其余对象溢出到 HBF：权重优先先放权重，再按地址顺序放 KV 块，其中包括保留的前缀；KV 优先先放运行中序列的 KV，再放权重，最后放保留的前缀。在分层模式（tiered mode）中，HBM 以 4 MiB 缓存行为单位，缓存 HBF 或其他容量层中的对象，使用 LRU、FIFO 或衰减 LFU [23] 进行替换；衰减 LFU 淘汰近期访问次数最少的行，并定期将所有访问计数减半，与基于频率的替换方式相同 [23]。脏数据按 4 KiB 粒度跟踪；脏 KV 既可在计算使链路空闲时积极回写 [12]，也可仅在缓存行被淘汰时回写。淘汰前已释放的 KV 直接丢弃，不再写入。

source_fragments.text: 3.3 Device Engine

blocks.original_text: HBM. An HBM stack follows the JEDEC organization of its generation, set by the number of channels and pseudo-channels and the pin rate. The following study uses HBM4 for analysis [8], with 32 channels of two pseudo-channels at 8 Gb/s per pin, or 2 TB/s per stack. Because our studies concern capacity tiers, HBFSim models HBM at the pseudo-channel level rather than at the command level of DRAM simulators such as Ramulator 2.0 [16]. Requests are split into pseudo-channel transfers, groups of four pseudo-channels share an arbitration queue and a service timeline, and an average access latency and a bandwidth efficiency account for row activation and refresh.
blocks.translation: HBM。HBM 堆栈遵循其代际的 JEDEC 组织方式，由通道数、伪通道数和引脚速率决定。下文使用 HBM4 进行分析 [8]：32 个通道，每通道两个伪通道，引脚速率为 8 Gb/s，即每堆栈 2 TB/s。由于研究关注容量层，HBFSim 在伪通道层面建模 HBM，而非像 Ramulator 2.0 [16] 等 DRAM 模拟器那样建模到命令级。请求被拆成伪通道传输，每四个伪通道共享仲裁队列与服务时间线，使用平均访问延迟和带宽效率表示行激活与刷新造成的影响。

blocks.original_text: HBF. As in the OCP specification, the model separates the device from its host-side management. The device has independent transmit and receive timelines for each channel, ordered page sensing within each bank, page buffers, ECC, and TSV transfers. It programs the pages of a block in order and, as the specification requires, erases a block when its first page is written. The organization of flash into channels, dies, planes, and blocks and the timing of reads, programs, and erases follow MQSim [29]. We reimplemented them because MQSim’s FTL runs inside an SSD, whereas HBF’s runs on the host, and HBF operations must share one timeline with HBM and the serving frontend. Like an SSD, and beyond the specification, each stack has a device-managed DRAM that buffers writes until a page is full and caches recently read pages. The host runs the FTL. It maps logical pages to physical ones and runs garbage collection, which picks victim blocks by their number of valid pages with a small weight for wear; static wear leveling is implemented but switched off in our studies. Since the specification forbids the device from moving valid data, garbage collection reads live pages into a copy buffer in HBM and writes them back. We implemented three mappings and keep each one’s index in HBM. Page-level mapping has an 8-byte entry per 4 KiB page; the whole table lives in flash as translation pages, and HBM caches part of it. Extent mapping keeps a sorted list of runs of consecutive pages, 48 B per run. Both write by appending and spread consecutive pages over all planes. Block-level mapping has one entry per 1 MiB logical block and keeps the block in one physical block on one plane, each page at a fixed offset. We model two consequences: NAND programs a block’s pages in order, so a page whose predecessors have not been written yet waits in the device DRAM; and any write that is not an in-order append copies the whole block to a fresh one. We do not stripe blocks over planes, because a copy would then move a 1.5 GiB stripe. Every mapping gets 0.1% of the HBF capacity in HBM, 3.1 GiB of the 96 GiB of two HBM4 stacks, and its lookups compete with the application’s traffic: with page-level mapping, one Llama-3.1-70B decoding step at 2 HBM + 6 HBF issues $1.0\text{–}1.7\times10^7$ lookups, one per flash page read.

blocks.translation: 3.4 模拟速度

source_fragments.text: 3.4 Simulation Speed

blocks.original_text: To make full-iteration simulation tractable, we combine coarse-grained HBM approximation with exact HBF acceleration. Only HBM is approximated: scheduling transfers per 4 KiB chunk and pseudo-channel rather than per 32-byte burst runs an all-HBM forward pass 24.8× faster (134.7× for sequential reads), while keeping batch completion times within 0.04%.
blocks.translation: 为使完整迭代模拟的开销可承受，我们结合粗粒度 HBM 近似与保持精确性的 HBF 加速。只有 HBM 使用近似：以 4 KiB 数据块和伪通道为单位调度传输，而不是逐个 32 字节突发传输，使全 HBM 前向执行的模拟速度达到原来的 24.8 倍，顺序读取时达到 134.7 倍，同时批次完成时间误差保持在 0.04% 以内。

grained HBM approximation with exact HBF acceleration. Only
HBM is approximated: scheduling transfers per 4 KiB chunk and

blocks.original_text: For HBF, the bottleneck is reserving roughly a dozen shared resources per page, as in SimpleSSD [9]; here we reduce per-reservation overhead without sacrificing accuracy. A first-fit calendar organizes each resource’s idle intervals into 64-interval leaves labeled with their maximum duration, so searches immediately bypass leaves with insufficient space. Multi-page reads are batched into groups of one page per plane to share stage-time calculations, reuse calendar lookup states across groups, and compute stride addresses from the first page, while the FTL updates free space only for planes whose state changes. Page grouping speeds up a Llama-3.1-70B batch (7.3M page reads) by 1.48×, and lazy FTL recounting accelerates ten write batches (3.2M page programs) by 1.55×. Every page still reserves all resources in strict order without pruning or rounding idle intervals, yielding bit-identical completion times across all 82,449 transactions in the batch.
blocks.translation: 对于 HBF，瓶颈与 SimpleSSD [9] 类似：每个页都要预留约十余种共享资源；我们在不牺牲准确性的前提下降低每次预留的开销。采用首次适配搜索的资源日历，将每种资源的空闲区间组织为每叶包含 64 个区间的结构，并标注叶内最大区间长度，从而在搜索时立即跳过没有足够空间的叶。多页读取按每平面一页分组，以共享阶段时间计算、跨组复用日历查找状态，并由第一页计算步长地址；FTL 则仅更新状态发生变化的平面的空闲空间。页分组使一个 Llama-3.1-70B 批次（7.3M 次页读取）的模拟加速 1.48 倍；FTL 延迟重计数使十个写入批次（3.2M 次页编程）的模拟加速 1.55 倍。每个页仍严格按顺序预留全部资源，不裁剪或舍入空闲区间，因此该批次全部 82,449 个事务的完成时间与原实现逐比特一致。

source_fragments.text: 3.5 Calibration and Validation

blocks.original_text: Three components are calibrated against hardware (Figure 3a). The scheduler is checked against vLLM 0.26’s: both receive the same requests and the same measured batch times, and over 282 batches in ten test cases with staggered arrivals, shared prefixes, prefix eviction, and preemption, they form the same batches with the same token ranges, prefix hits, and completion times. The operator model is fitted to kernel measurements: on an A100 and an H200 NVL we timed the Marlin GEMMs and FlashAttention-2 paged attention that vLLM uses with 8-bit weights, inside whole layers under CUDA graphs, over 525 shapes per GPU spanning batch, query, and context sizes, and fitted each operator’s fixed overhead, compute rate, and memory rate by least squares. We then predict 64 whole-layer shapes that never entered the fit: the mean absolute error is 5.8% on the A100 and 5.0% on the H200, and the largest, 41.8% on the A100, occurs in Llama-3.1-70B layers whose batch mixes long and short contexts. Finally we run complete requests on each GPU, from the embedding to the output head, and compare each batch’s time: predicted and measured batch times differ by 10.2% on average on the A100 (Llama-3.1-8B, 46 batches) and by 5.8% on the H200 (Llama-3.1-8B and Llama-3.1-70B, 86 batches); for Llama-3.1-70B on the H200, the time to first token differs by 9.3–13.6% and TPOT by 4.6–7.0%. The host DRAM path is fitted to measured pinned-memory copies between an H200 NVL and its host (issue time, bandwidth per direction, fixed latency).

blocks.original_text: System. We model one accelerator package with eight memory stacks, each an HBM4 stack or an HBF stack (Table 1); we write 2 HBM + 6 HBF for a package of two HBM and six HBF stacks (2:6 in the figures, 2H6F in Table 3). We compare 1 HBM + 7 HBF, 2 HBM + 6 HBF, 4 HBM + 4 HBF, and 6 HBM + 2 HBF, whose HBM holds 43.4, 91.9, 188.9, and 285.9 GiB of data. The HBF stacks follow OCP speed grade 2, with 16 channels, one die per channel, 16 planes per die, and blocks of 256 pages of 4 KiB. Like an SSD, each HBF stack has a device DRAM of 0.1% of its flash that serves as write buffer and read cache. Unless noted otherwise, the host FTL uses page-level mapping and caches translation pages in 0.1% of the HBF capacity, reserved in HBM. We serve Llama-3.1-70B [5] with 8-bit weights (67.7 GiB) and a BF16 KV cache (320 KiB per token), and Qwen3-235B-A22B with FP8 weights (223.0 GiB for the 128 experts of each of its 94 MoE layers) and a BF16 KV cache (188 KiB per token); the figures label them 70B and 235B. Public traces carry no expert routes, so the 235B model routes every token to a uniformly random top-8 of its 128 experts, seeded by the token’s prefix; at 32 sequences a decode step reads 197.9 GiB of the 223 GiB of weights. GPU compute follows the H200 NVL operator profile (Section 3.5), which covers batches of up to 16; for larger batches we keep the per-FLOP and per-byte costs measured at 16.

blocks.original_text: Workloads. A decode step reads the KV of every running sequence, so what distinguishes workloads is how much context the sequences hold and how that context was produced. We characterize a workload by its input:output length ratio and compare three (Table 2): long OUTPUT (2K prompt tokens, 6K output tokens), balanced (4K and 4K), and long INPUT (6K and 2K), 8K tokens per request in each. The public traces of Mooncake [22] and Qwen [31] are input-heavy (at most 29% of their requests have more than 62.5% of their tokens in the output), so no output-heavy workload can be drawn from them; their median request holds 5.5K–7.3K tokens. Prompts are private, so no KV is shared. We replay each workload through the scheduler with 32 sequences per batch and a prefix cache that retains 1M tokens (320 GiB of KV for Llama-3.1-70B, 188 GiB for Qwen3-235B-A22B). The first batch’s requests arrive spread over one request’s lifetime, so in the steady state the running sequences are at every stage of their lifetimes. Among the steps in which every batch slot is busy while requests wait and the prefix cache is full, we take the one whose running sequences hold the median context and install its state as replayed, each KV block at its replayed address. We then measure a short window instead of a full replay: each sequence prefills a private 16-token suffix, which resumes it as a running request and yields its first token, and decodes seven more; TPOT is the mean time of these seven decode steps. The three workloads hold 5.2K, 6.3K, and 7.3K tokens of context on average, so a step reads 51–71 GiB of KV for Llama-3.1-70B and 30–42 GiB for Qwen3-235B-A22B, 40% more under long INPUT than under long OUTPUT, and writes one token of KV per sequence.

blocks.original_text: 4.2 HBF Versus Other Capacity Tiers
blocks.translation: 4.2 HBF 与其他容量层的比较

source_fragments.text: 4.2 HBF Versus Other Capacity Tiers

blocks.original_text: At 2 HBM + 6 HBF with weights first, the capacity tier serves 38–65 GiB of running KV per step for Llama-3.1-70B and 145–157 GiB for Qwen3-235B-A22B, whose 223 GiB of weights exceed HBM: 115 GiB of weights and all 30–42 GiB of running KV. We keep this placement and replace the six HBF stacks with host DRAM, a CXL SSD, or an NVMe SSD of the same capacity (Figure 4a). HBF decodes 11.0–14.4× faster than host DRAM, 16.1–21.3× faster than the CXL SSD, and 86.6–115.0× faster than the NVMe SSD for Llama-3.1-70B, and 18.6–19.0×, 66.8–154.1×, and 150.3–154.1× faster for Qwen3-235B-A22B. The step time is roughly the tier read divided by the tier’s bandwidth: six on-package HBF stacks serve 157 GiB in 0.17 s, PCIe-attached host DRAM in 3.2 s, and the NVMe SSD’s NAND at 6.6 GB/s in 26 s. The CXL SSD’s device DRAM (5% of its flash, 153.6 GiB) holds the spill of Llama-3.1-70B and of the first two Qwen3-235B-A22B workloads, so the CXL SSD stays within 1.5× of host DRAM there; the 157 GiB spill of long INPUT exceeds it and the CXL SSD is as slow as the NVMe SSD (26.0 s). We keep all 32 sequences in every system, so each tier serves the same spill; a real system would shrink the batch.

blocks.original_text: An off-package tier occupies none of the package’s eight stack sites, which can then hold HBM. Figure 4b therefore compares seven systems on eight sites, all with KV first: 2 HBM + 6 HBF; 2 HBM with the HBF’s capacity off package as a CXL or NVMe SSD, alone or behind 256 GiB of host DRAM (one accelerator’s share of a 2 TiB server), leaving six sites empty; and 8 HBM with the CXL SSD, alone or behind host DRAM. With two HBM stacks, the weights that do not fit in HBM come from the tier in every step: 2 HBM + 6 HBF is 9.3–12.5× faster than 2 HBM + host DRAM + CXL SSD for Llama-3.1-70B and 19.1–19.5× for Qwen3-235B-A22B. Host DRAM holds the first 256 GiB of the tier, which covers both models’ weights, so the SSD behind it is never read and the NVMe and CXL variants coincide. The SSDs alone are 13.5–18.3× (CXL) and 70.8–98.0× (NVMe) slower than 2 HBM + 6 HBF for Llama-3.1-70B, and 66.9–99.3× and 154.3–157.2× for Qwen3-235B-A22B. With eight HBM stacks (384 GiB), both working sets fit, no step reads the off-package tier, and TPOT is 49–55 ms: 1.4–1.5× below 2 HBM + 6 HBF for Llama-3.1-70B and 2.9× below it for Qwen3-235B-A22B. An off-package tier thus wins only when the sites it frees go to HBM and the step fits in that HBM; then a cheap tier serves as well as a fast one.

blocks.original_text: 4.3 How Much HBM, and What Should It Hold?
blocks.translation: 4.3 需要多少 HBM，以及 HBM 应保存什么

source_fragments.text: 4.3 How Much HBM, and What Should It Hold?

blocks.original_text: Capacity and placement. We vary the split between HBM and HBF (Figure 5). In peer mode, HBM should give priority to the running sequences’ KV. The working set of Llama-3.1-70B (119–139 GiB) fits at 4 HBM + 4 HBF, where KV first and tiered mode reach the compute-bound 49–54 ms. At 2 HBM + 6 HBF, KV first takes 69–83 ms and weights first 75–95 ms, 4–14% more: it fills the HBM left after the weights with KV blocks in address order, retained prefixes included, and leaves 38–65 GiB of running KV in HBF per step, whereas KV first reads only weights from HBF (29–49 GiB). At 1 HBM + 7 HBF even KV first reads 8–28 GiB of running KV per step from HBF (89–98 ms). Under long OUTPUT, weights first still takes 75 ms at 4 HBM + 4 HBF, where the working set fits, because the added HBM fills with retained prefixes while 31 GiB of running KV per step still come from HBF. The working set of Qwen3-235B-A22B (253–265 GiB) exceeds HBM at all three splits. Its decode step is dominated by the 198 GiB of expert weights it reads, so KV first falls only gradually, from 163–170 ms at 1 HBM + 7 HBF and 152–160 ms at 2 HBM + 6 HBF to 115–128 ms at 4 HBM + 4 HBF, and weights first is 4–7% behind. At 1 HBM + 7 HBF the step takes only 7% longer than at 2 HBM + 6 HBF: seven HBF stacks serve the experts. The three workloads differ little: their contexts differ by 1K tokens, and TPOT follows (69, 76, and 83 ms with KV first at 2 HBM + 6 HBF): a step’s cost depends on how much context it reads, not on how it was produced.

blocks.original_text: Tiered mode. Tiered mode matches peer mode with KV first when the working set fits in HBM and, with LRU or FIFO, is 1.7–2.2× slower for Llama-3.1-70B and 1.3–2.4× for Qwen3-235B-A22B when it does not. blocks.original_text: Replacement. No policy wins everywhere. FIFO rereads the same bytes as LRU in another order: within 1% of LRU for Qwen3-235B-A22B and 1–20% faster for Llama-3.1-70B. blocks.original_text: Hot experts. The uniform router is the worst case for a cache. We therefore rerun Qwen3-235B-A22B with a Zipf router of exponent $\alpha$ (Figure 6), so that a step reads 64%, 46%, and 34% of the experts at $\alpha=1,1.5,2$ instead of 88%. At 4 HBM + 4 HBF, where $\alpha=1.5$ leaves 135–147 GiB in 188.9, decayed LFU takes 0.83–0.87 of the KV-first time and LRU 0.89–1.00; at $\alpha=2$ they take 0.78 and 0.81–0.83: the cache keeps every layer’s hot experts, whereas the address-ordered split keeps whole early layers and misses those of the late ones. blocks.original_text: Takeaway 2: Under the evaluated workloads and 4 MiB cache-line configuration, the tested replacement policies incur substantial refill traffic when the active working set exceeds HBM capacity. None of the evaluated policies matches peer mode with KV first once the set a step reads exceeds HBM, and they beat it only when that set fits with room to spare, because none captures the distinct access patterns, mutability, and lifetimes of inference data. Effective HBF management therefore requires inference-aware placement and migration rather than generic cache replacement.

blocks.original_text: In decode, HBF mostly serves reads, so we ask what the FTL costs on the read path and how fast writes wear HBF.
blocks.translation: 解码期间，HBF 主要服务读取，因此我们研究 FTL 在读取路径上的成本，以及写入会以多快的速度磨损 HBF。

on the read path and how fast writes wear HBF.

blocks.original_text: Address translation. We compare the three mappings of Section 3.3 at 2 HBM + 6 HBF with weights first, so that the running KV is read from HBF (Figure 8). A decode step writes almost nothing, so we also run the prefill windows of Section 4.3 (46–47 GiB of new KV each). All three receive the same 3.1 GiB of HBM, but only page-level mapping uses a sizable part of it: 97–152 MiB of translation pages for the pages a decode step touches, against 0.9 MiB for the extent index and 10 MiB for the block index. Extent mapping stays within 0.5% of page-level mapping in decode and in prefill: KV is written and read in long runs, so one index entry serves many pages. Block-level mapping is 4.2–4.3× slower in decode (324–399 against 75–95 ms), because a block lies on one plane, which reads its 256 pages one after another in about 1.0 ms, whereas the other two mappings spread the same pages over all planes; prefill, which spends more of its time in compute, hides part of this and is 1.5× slower.
blocks.translation: 地址转换。我们在 2 HBM＋6 HBF、权重优先的条件下比较第 3.3 节的三种映射，使运行中 KV 从 HBF 读取（图 8）。解码步几乎不写入，因此还运行第 4.3 节的预填充窗口，每种产生 46–47 GiB 新 KV。三种映射均获得相同的 3.1 GiB HBM，但只有页级映射使用其中较大的一部分：为一个解码步所触及页面缓存的转换页为 97–152 MiB，相比之下，区段索引为 0.9 MiB，块索引为 10 MiB。区段映射在解码和预填充中的耗时与页级映射相差均不超过 0.5%，因为 KV 以长连续区间读写，一个索引条目就能服务许多页。块级映射的解码耗时为 324–399 ms，而页级映射为 75–95 ms，耗时为页级映射的 4.2–4.3 倍；因为一个块位于单一平面上，其 256 页需在约 1.0 ms 内逐页顺序读取，而另外两种映射将同样的页分散到所有平面。预填充中计算占比更大，能掩盖部分影响，因此耗时约为页级映射的 1.5 倍。

blocks.original_text: Takeaway 4: HBF mapping should preserve internal parallelism rather than maximize address granularity. Decode reads weights and KV in long sequential runs, so one translation serves many pages. An extent mapping that stripes each run across all planes matches a page-level table at a fraction of its memory, whereas a block-level mapping that keeps each block on a single plane serializes its page reads and slows decoding considerably.
blocks.translation: 结论 4：HBF 映射应保持内部并行性，而不是一味追求更粗的地址映射粒度。解码以长连续区间读取权重和 KV，因此一次地址转换能够服务许多页。将各区段条带化到全部平面的区段映射，只使用页表一小部分的内存就能达到页级映射的性能；而将每个块固定在单一平面的块级映射，会将页读取串行化，显著拖慢解码。

blocks.original_text: Lifetime. A decode step writes one token of KV per sequence, so wear comes from new KV written into flash, and we estimate lifetime at a published peak load. TensorRT-LLM reaches 489 output tokens/s per H200 for Llama-3.3-70B, which has the architecture of Llama-3.1-70B, with 5,000-token prompts and 500-token outputs [18], 1.64 GiB/s of new KV per GPU. The published table has no Qwen3-235B-A22B, so we apply the same token rate to it; with 188 KiB of KV per token against 320 KiB, it writes 41% less. HBFSim measures the share of this KV that reaches HBF with weights first (87.5–100%) and replays each workload’s KV writes and releases (about 1 TiB, twice the stack’s capacity) through one HBF stack with garbage collection, which gives the flash bytes erased per written byte in steady state, the quantity that consumes P/E cycles. With either mapping this is 1.0 within 0.1%: KV is appended and freed in bulk, so one block with no valid page left is erased per MiB written. Block-level mapping programs 1.5–3.5% fewer pages, because pages that wait in the device DRAM for their block’s unwritten prefix are dropped when a sequence ends, but their block is still erased. Assuming 100,000 P/E cycles, as for the SLC NAND used in HBF designs [32], Table 3 gives the resulting lifetime: 24–83 months for Llama-3.1-70B and 40–141 months for Qwen3-235B-A22B, in proportion to the HBF stacks that share the writes and the same with either mapping: how long HBF lasts is set by how much KV reaches flash.
blocks.translation: 寿命。解码步为每个序列写入一个词元的 KV，因此磨损来自写入闪存的新 KV；我们使用已公布的峰值负载估算寿命。在每请求 5,000 个提示词和 500 个输出词元时，TensorRT-LLM 在每个 H200 上运行 Llama-3.3-70B 可达到每秒 489 个输出词元，该模型架构与 Llama-3.1-70B 相同 [18]；每 GPU 由此产生 1.64 GiB/s 新 KV。公布的表中没有 Qwen3-235B-A22B，因此我们对它使用相同词元速率；其每词元 KV 为 188 KiB，而非 320 KiB，写入量少 41%。HBFSim 测量权重优先时到达 HBF 的 KV 比例，为 87.5–100%；随后将各工作负载的 KV 写入与释放轨迹，约 1 TiB、相当于堆栈容量两倍，通过一个启用垃圾回收的 HBF 堆栈回放，由此得到稳态下每写入一字节对应的闪存擦除字节数，这才是消耗 P/E 循环的量。各种映射下这一比值都为 1.0，偏差在 0.1% 内：KV 以大块形式追加和释放，因此每写入 1 MiB，就擦除一个已无有效页的块。块级映射少编程 1.5–3.5% 的页，因为等待块内尚未写入前缀的页会在序列结束时从器件 DRAM 中丢弃，但其所在块仍会被擦除。假定耐久性为 100,000 次 P/E 循环，与 HBF 设计中所用 SLC NAND 相同 [32]，表 3 给出预计寿命：Llama-3.1-70B 为 24–83 个月，Qwen3-235B-A22B 为 40–141 个月；寿命与分担写入的 HBF 堆栈数成正比，各种映射得到的结果相同。HBF 能使用多久，由到达闪存的 KV 数量决定。

blocks.original_text: Only the rate at which the flash array senses pages matters. Doubling the page read time to 8 μs raises TPOT by 30–42%, 16 μs by 91–126%, and the 40 μs of conventional NAND by 3.7–4.8×; halving the planes per die at equal capacity has the same effect as doubling the read time (29–40% for 8 planes, 87–121% for 4). The interface does not matter: speed grade 3 doubles grade 2’s 1.5 TB/s and changes TPOT by 0.1%, and grades 1 and 2 on 8 channels are equally 29–40% slower, only because their stacks have half the planes. A plane senses one 4 KiB page per read time, so a stack’s 256 planes deliver 0.26 TB/s at 4 μs, a sixth of the interface. The write side is invisible in decode, even without the device DRAM: with KV first a step appends its KV in HBM and programs no HBF page, so program times from 37.5 to 600 μs, write credits, and write timeout leave TPOT unchanged, and the thermal throttling ceiling adds at most 0.2%. For read-heavy decode, an HBF design should therefore spend on planes and read time before interface speed.

source_fragments.text: 5 DISCUSSION

blocks.original_text: Limitations. Our case studies reproduce one decoding step per workload, seven tokens per running sequence, and one prefill window per workload for the write path and the mapping comparison, without garbage collection, so TPOT omits its interference with reads. We model one accelerator; tensor or pipeline parallelism would give each a share of the weights and KV. The studies combine an H200 compute profile, extended beyond its measured batch of 16, with HBM4 and HBF, a pairing that does not exist today, so HBF timing and endurance remain assumptions. The lifetime estimates apply a published serving load around the clock to the HBF write share and write amplification that HBFSim measures, and assume perfect wear leveling.
blocks.translation: 局限性。案例研究为每种工作负载重现一个代表性解码步，每个运行中序列继续生成七个词元；写入路径和映射比较则各使用一个预填充窗口，且不包含垃圾回收，因此 TPOT 没有计入 GC 对读取的干扰。我们只建模一个加速器；若采用张量或流水线并行，每个加速器只承担部分权重和 KV。研究将 H200 计算配置外推到其已测批量 16 之外，并与 HBM4、HBF 配对，这一组合目前并不存在，因此 HBF 时序和耐久性仍是假设。寿命估计将已公布的服务负载全天候施加到 HBFSim 测出的 HBF 写入比例及写放大上，并假设完美磨损均衡。

blocks.original_text: 7 CONCLUSION
blocks.translation: 7 结论

source_fragments.text: 7 CONCLUSION

blocks.original_text: HBF could give accelerators an order of magnitude more memory, but only if systems use it in ways that suit flash. HBFSim lets researchers test these choices before hardware exists. Our case studies support five takeaways. HBF is most valuable under capacity pressure, where it keeps TPOT 11.0–19.0× lower than host DRAM and 86.6–154.1× lower than an NVMe SSD. Conventional cache replacement is a poor fit for HBM–HBF tiering: no policy matches peer mode with KV first once the set a step reads exceeds HBM, and a cache wins only when that set fits with room to spare. HBM should hold the running sequences’ KV and HBF the read-only weights; KV should move to HBF only when it must leave HBM. The mapping should preserve the flash array’s parallelism, which an extent index does at a fraction of a page table’s memory. Endurance is a first-order constraint: at a published peak load of Llama-3.1-70B, HBF lasts 2.0 to 6.9 years, in proportion to the stacks that share the KV writes. We release HBFSim so that others can replace our assumptions with measurements.
blocks.translation: HBF 可以为加速器提供高一个数量级的存储容量，但前提是系统按照适合闪存的方式使用它。HBFSim 使研究者能在硬件出现前测试这些选择。案例研究支持五条结论：HBF 在容量压力下最有价值，此时，主机 DRAM 的 TPOT 为 HBF 的 11.0–19.0 倍，NVMe SSD 为其 86.6–154.1 倍。传统缓存替换不适合 HBM—HBF 分层：只要单步读取集合超过 HBM，没有一种策略能够达到 KV 优先并列模式的性能；仅在集合能够放下且留有充足余量时，缓存才占优。HBM 应保存运行中序列的 KV，HBF 保存只读权重；KV 仅在必须离开 HBM 时才移入 HBF。映射应保持闪存阵列的并行性，区段索引能以页表一小部分的内存做到这一点。耐久性是必须优先考虑的约束：在已公布的 Llama-3.1-70B 峰值负载下，HBF 可使用 2.0–6.9 年，并与分担 KV 写入的堆栈数成正比。我们发布 HBFSim，使其他研究者能够用测量值替换这些假设。

captions.original_text: Figure 1: Weights (one byte per parameter) and BF16 KV cache of a 1M-token context against the HBM of one H200, eight HBM4 stacks, and an eight-H200 node.
captions.translation: 图 1：模型权重（每参数一字节）和 100 万词元上下文的 BF16 KV 缓存，与单个 H200、八个 HBM4 堆栈及一个八 H200 节点的 HBM 容量对比。

captions.original_text: Figure 2: HBFSim structure: three layers. Feedback from the device engine closes the loop to the scheduler, and the host FTL keeps its tables and GC copies in HBM.
captions.translation: 图 2：HBFSim 的三层结构。器件引擎向调度器反馈结果，形成闭环；主机 FTL 将映射表和垃圾回收复制数据保存在 HBM 中。

captions.original_text: Figure 3: Calibration and simulation cost. (a) Absolute error of predicted time for held-out layer shapes and for complete-request batches. (b) Host time of the 405 configurations of Section 4 against their flash page reads; configurations without flash reads sit on the vertical axis.
captions.translation: 图 3：校准与模拟成本。(a) 留出验证的层形状和完整请求批次的预测时间绝对误差。(b) 第 4 节 405 种配置的主机运行时间与闪存页读取次数的关系；没有闪存读取的配置位于纵轴上。

captions.original_text: Figure 4: Mean TPOT at the decode step of each workload (logarithmic axes). (a) HBF against the other capacity tiers at 2 HBM + 6 HBF, peer mode with the weights placed first in HBM. (b) The tiers as systems with eight stack sites: 2 HBM + 6 HBF, or 2 or 8 HBM with the HBF’s capacity off package as a CXL SSD or an NVMe SSD, alone or behind 256 GiB of host DRAM; KV placed first in HBM.
captions.translation: 图 4：各工作负载代表性解码步的平均 TPOT，采用对数坐标。(a) 在 2 HBM＋6 HBF 配置、并列模式且 HBM 优先放权重时，将 HBF 与其他容量层比较。(b) 在八个堆栈位置下比较系统：2 HBM＋6 HBF，或者两个／八个 HBM 搭配封装外 CXL SSD 或 NVMe SSD，其容量与 HBF 相同；SSD 可以直接使用，也可以位于 256 GiB 主机 DRAM 之后；HBM 优先放 KV。

captions.original_text: Figure 5: Mean TPOT across HBM:HBF stack splits. Peer mode gives HBM first to the weights or to the running sequences’ KV; tiered mode replaces by LRU, FIFO, or decayed LFU and writes back on eviction.
captions.translation: 图 5：不同 HBM:HBF 堆栈配比下的平均 TPOT。并列模式让 HBM 优先保存权重或运行中序列的 KV；分层模式使用 LRU、FIFO 或衰减 LFU 替换，并在淘汰时回写。

captions.original_text: Figure 6: Qwen3-235B-A22B under skewed expert popularity (balanced workload; legend as in Figure 5): a token’s top-8 experts are drawn with weight $(r+1)^{-\alpha}$ over a seeded per-layer rank $r$. Tick labels: share of the experts a step reads.
captions.translation: 图 6：专家热度偏斜时的 Qwen3-235B-A22B，采用均衡工作负载，图例与图 5 相同。对每一层，通过随机种子确定排名 $r$，按权重 $(r+1)^{-\alpha}$ 抽取一个词元的 top-8 专家。横轴刻度同时标出单步读取的专家比例。

captions.original_text: Figure 7: Decode throughput of Qwen3-235B-A22B against the batch size, peer mode with KV first.
captions.translation: 图 7：Qwen3-235B-A22B 的解码吞吐量随批量大小变化，采用 KV 优先的并列模式。

captions.original_text: Figure 8: Page-level, extent, and block mapping for Llama-3.1-70B at 2 HBM + 6 HBF, weights first: the index kept for the pages a decode step touches (bar: largest workload; whisker: smallest), decode TPOT, and request time in the prefill windows of Section 4.3.
captions.translation: 图 8：Llama-3.1-70B 在 2 HBM＋6 HBF、权重优先下的页级、区段及块级映射：左图为解码步涉及页面所需保留的索引，柱高对应最大工作负载，须线对应最小工作负载；中图为解码 TPOT；右图为第 4.3 节预填充窗口的请求时间。

captions.original_text: Figure 9: TPOT of Llama-3.1-70B at 2 HBM + 6 HBF, KV first, when one HBF parameter changes (logarithmic axis). Dashed: default setting. Interface points give the OCP speed grade and channels per stack; 8-channel stacks have half the planes.
captions.translation: 图 9：在 2 HBM＋6 HBF、KV 优先下，每次改变一个 HBF 参数时 Llama-3.1-70B 的 TPOT，采用对数坐标。虚线表示默认设置。接口参数点给出 OCP 速度等级和每堆栈通道数；8 通道堆栈的平面数减半。

captions.original_text: Table 1: Memory devices of capacity tiers.
captions.translation: 表 1：容量层使用的存储器件。

captions.original_text: Table 2: Workloads at the representative decode step: prompt and output tokens per request, mean context of the running sequences (Ctx), KV read per step (KV, GiB), and working set of weights and KV (WS, GiB).
captions.translation: 表 2：代表性解码步的工作负载。INPUT、OUTPUT 为每请求的提示词与输出词元数；Ctx 为运行中序列的平均上下文；KV 为每步 KV 读取量，单位 GiB；WS 为权重与 KV 的工作集，单位 GiB。
